title: Poached Egg in a Microwave
description: Easiest way ever to poach eggs—all you need is a mug and a microwave! Ready in about 2 minutes. Use this poached egg method to top a quick lunch salad, toast for an easy breakfast, or roasted vegetables for dinner. Older eggs have runny whites that do not poach well.
ingredients: 1 large egg, straight from the refrigerator
directions: Put 1/4 cup water in an 8-ounce glass measuring cup or sturdy, microwave-safe mug.
Microwave on high power for 1 minute.

Crack the egg into the water. Gently slide a toothpick into the yolk, keeping it intact. Cover the measuring cup or mug with plastic wrap (if using a mug, you may use a small microwave-safe saucer instead).
(Very occasionally, the yolk can explode in the microwave. Piercing the yolk and covering the mug keeps the process safe and neat.)

The cook time here will depend a lot on the wattage of your microwave. Start with 35 seconds, and keep adding time as needed in 10-second increments if needed. Egg overcooked? Next time, try cooking it for only 30 seconds after adding the egg to the water.
Using a spoon or fork, gently lift the egg out of the mug and set it on a slice of toasted bread or a paper towel.
Transfer to your serving plate, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and enjoy.
